subject: secondswap-2024-12
candidate_invariant: a user cannot list/sell more than maxSellPercent of their original (locked) allocation onto the secondary market
suspected_break: repeated buy-and-resell cycles inflate allocations[user].bought, which raises the user's sellLimit, letting a cartel sell more than maxSellPercent of the original allocation
affected_actor: the vesting issuer / honest market (the sell-restriction is bypassed)
attacker_or_trigger_actor: a seller cooperating with one or more sybil buyer addresses
expected_impact: Medium - vesting sell-restriction (maxSellPercent) bypassable, defeats a core protocol invariant
known_unknowns: exact fee cost of each wash cycle vs the amount of extra sell headroom unlocked

depth_trace.controlled_inputs: EOA seller + sybil buyer addresses; repeated list/spotPurchase cycles
depth_trace.pre_state: allocations[seller].sold=0, bought=0; original locked allocation A; maxSellPercent=2000 (20%)
depth_trace.operation_trace: seller lists 20% to sybil; sybil.bought += amount -> sybil.sellLimit rises by that amount; sybil re-lists; cumulative tokens sold across the cartel exceed 20% of A
depth_trace.boundary_cases: after N cycles the cartel's aggregate sold > maxSellPercent*A; the per-user require(sold<=sellLimit) never trips because bought inflates sellLimit
depth_trace.post_state: more than maxSellPercent of the original locked allocation has reached external buyers; restriction defeated

adversarial_ordering.relied_upon_invariant: a user cannot list/sell more than maxSellPercent of their original allocation
adversarial_ordering.counterexample_trace: seller->sybil purchase increments sybil.bought; sellLimit = bought + maxSell% of (alloc+sold-bought); repeated buy/resell cycles grow `bought`, raising sellLimit beyond the intended 20% cap on the original allocation
actor_interleavings_tested: seller A vs sybil buyer B repeated cycles
